description: Public digital twins of real places (print farms, factories, warehouses, ports, airports, streets) near a point, nearest first. Each row has data: mode (observed, recorded, simulated, mixed), source, rate, method, and for live feeds last (unix s) and age_s.

kind.description: only this kind: printfarm, factory, warehouse, truck, airport, port, city, robot, sim

mode.description: only twins whose numbers are this: observed (live feed), recorded (real data replayed), simulated, mixed

place.description: a city or 'district, city' (e.g. 'Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen'); or give lat and lon

name: twins_near
title: Digital twins near a place
